Candle construction is governed by two independent
axes: bar type and aggregation method.

17 base bar types: time, tick, volume, dollar,
Renko, range, volatility, Heikin-Ashi, Kagi,

Line Break, P&F, tick imbalance (TIB), volume

imbalance (VIB), run, CUSUM, entropy, delta.

3 aggregation methods: calendar-aligned, rolling

window, adaptive rolling.

17 x 3 = 51 combinations. Most systems use only 1
(calendar time bars ). The other 50 are untapped.

Recommendation: Use combinations in layers—

rolling time for signals, calendar for structure,
information-driven for microstructure.
